name: 猫咪品种二选一 Cat Breed Choice
description: 非街道演示：40 个真实猫咪品种，每个品种多张 CC0、公有领域或 CC BY 照片。每一轮从两个品种中各抽一张，强制二选一，共 8 轮，中英文字。 Non-street demo: 40 real cat breeds, several CC0, public-domain, or CC BY photos each. Each trial draws one photo from each of two breeds. Forced pairwise choice, 8 trials, English and Chinese.
author: SP-Survey

config.title:
猫咪品种二选一
Cat Breed Choice
config.description:
这是一个非街道演示。每一轮比较两个猫咪品种，并从该品种的照片里抽一张，所以同一品种在不同轮次里可能是不同的照片。请选出你更喜欢的一只。
This is a non-street demo. Each trial compares two breeds and draws one photograph from each breed, so later trials can show a different photo of a breed you already saw. Choose the cat you prefer.

pages.name: cat_choice_page
pages.title: 二选一 Pairwise choice
pages.description:
每一轮只出现两只猫，各来自一个品种。请选一只，不能打平。共 8 轮。
Each trial shows two cats, one from each of two breeds. Pick one. There is no tie. 8 trials.
